task_completion.description: The agent navigated to the Control Panel or My Settings to configure the profile.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing the Sugar Control Panel or 'About Me' settings window open.
The text 'AlexC' visible in the nickname input field within the settings or reflected under the XO icon in the Home view.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The XO icon in the settings or the center of the Home view appearing in shades of orange or yellow instead of the initial red/blue.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The Write activity interface (word processor) is visible on the screen.

task_completion.visual_evidence: Text within the Write activity showing 'Alex Chen', a description of the orange/yellow color, and a date string.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The activity title bar or the Journal view showing an entry named 'Student Setup Log'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sugar graphical interface rather than just executing terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Control Panel and Write activity buttons.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed the log content rather than it appearing instantly via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the progression of text being entered in the Write activity.

integrity.description: The agent did not use 'gsettings' in the Terminal activity to bypass the UI task.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial nickname is 'Learner' and the initial color is red/blue (#FF2B34,#005FE4). The agent must change the nickname to exactly 'AlexC' and the color to an orange/yellow scheme. The final Journal entry must be titled 'Student Setup Log' and contain the name 'Alex Chen'.
